kind: synthetic frozen geometry evaluation methods declared before MoGe inference
pointEvaluation: official direct metric camera point map; (camera_points - oracle_translation) @ oracle_rotation after inference only
depth: same frozen depth/labels/ROI/boundary/visible-span and no-tail-trimming rules; original640x480 outputs; official binary mask only
anchor: optional original1.20m anchor scale applied to camera points about each fixed oracle camera origin, no camera/ICP/per-view/per-object fit
crossView: reuse prior fixed GT-visible correspondence eligibility without changes

planes.membership: analytic frozen truth ray/box nearest face; same primitive and face throughout fixed 3x3 neighbourhood; image rim excluded
planes.plane: signed perpendicular distance to known outward primitive face: mean, RMS, standard deviation; no fitted plane or prediction rejection
planes.normals: signed normalized cosine against outward analytic visible face; mean/median angle and fraction <=15 degrees; no absolute cosine

visualScales.normal: signed OpenCV camera vector mapped linearly from -1..1 to0..255

normalSource: official MoGe dataloader.py depth_map_to_normal_map and signed normal_map_loss; pinned utils3d cross(up,left) points toward camera (-Z on front-facing plane)
